summary: Tested new admin feature (statistiche demografiche). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (auth on /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/generate-daily, response shape validation, and end-to-end demographic aggregation after onboarding+vote for Lombardia/F/25-34). Frontend: /admin route works end-to-end — password gate renders with correct testIDs, wrong key shows 'Chiave admin non valida' in admin-error, CAMBIA CHIAVE resets the gate, correct key 'populus-admin-42b8f3' renders admin-screen with 3 stat cards (UTENTI/ONBOARDED/VOTI) and 4 SectionBlocks (regione, sesso, età, top feuds); admin-refresh re-fetches; admin-logout returns to gate. Profile 'PANNELLO ADMIN' link with testID='profile-admin-link' verified in code at profile.tsx bottom (line 237-244); could not exercise via UI in this run because the region picker on onboarding step 3 is a custom RN Picker not a native <select>, so scripted onboarding stalled at step 3 (not an admin bug).
action_items: Optional: consider making onboarding step-3 region picker easier to automate (e.g. add testID='onboarding-region-picker' and per-option testIDs). Not required for this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: require_admin correctly rejects empty ADMIN_TOKEN or mismatch with 401 'Chiave admin non valida'.
GET /api/admin/stats correctly excludes _id via $project and returns all expected buckets including 'unknown' for by_sex/by_age; by_region sorted desc.
POST /api/admin/generate-daily is now behind require_admin — previously public endpoint is protected as expected.
admin.tsx uses expo-secure-store via storage util; correctly hydrates state and clears key on logout.
profile-admin-link is rendered as the very last element of the ScrollView, matching the 'discreet link' spec.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (admin route fully tested; profile→admin link verified in code but not exercised via automation due to custom region picker on onboarding step 3)

seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ anonymous users during backend integration test; one onboarded to Lombardia/F/age 28 and voted once (persisted in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin feature verified end-to-end. Admin key: populus-admin-42b8f3. /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/generate-daily both require X-Admin-Key header. /admin route works standalone (no user auth needed). profile-admin-link testID exists but is only reachable after a user completes onboarding, and the region picker on step 3 is a custom RN Picker — automate it by opening the picker overlay and clicking the item, not via select_option.
